*Overdue installment penalty notice*

Dear {customer_name},

Your {installment_name} for Plot {plot_no} at {project}, due on {due_date}, remains unpaid.
*Unpaid installment amount:* {amount_due}

Please settle the overdue amount. If you have already paid, contact our office to reconcile your account.

Defence Garden Group
